title.en: Oct 26, 2026 | Would you give AI a computer of its own?
title.zh-CN: 2026 年 10 月 26 日｜你会给 AI 单独配一台电脑吗？

description.en: Within ten weeks, xAI, Meta, OpenAI and Anthropic each gave their AI assistant a separate cloud computer. NVIDIA, Perplexity and the startup Ghost brought that computer onto the desk, and some people have moved a Mac mini abroad to keep using Claude. Why does AI need its own computer, and should you give it one?
description.zh-CN: 十周之内，xAI、Meta、OpenAI、Anthropic 都给自己的 AI 助理配了一台独立的云电脑；NVIDIA、Perplexity 和创业公司 Ghost 把它搬到桌面上；还有人为了继续用 Claude，把 Mac mini 放到了海外。AI 为什么需要自己的电脑？你该不该给它配一台？

title.en: Oct 26, 2026 | AI is starting to operate software for you. What goes next, the UI or the software?
title.zh-CN: 2026 年 10 月 26 日｜AI 开始替你操作软件了：下一个被淘汰的是 UI，还是软件本身？

description.en: Agents are operating browsers, changing files and continuing work while users are away. Product announcements and Anthropic’s internal research suggest software value is shifting toward permissions, shared state and reviewing results.
description.zh-CN: AI 开始操作浏览器、修改文件，并在你离线后继续工作。界面会退到哪里，软件还凭什么收费？从产品的一手发布和 Anthropic 内部研究，看权限、协作与结果确认如何成为新的竞争焦点。

title.en: Oct 19, 2026 | When AI starts using software for you, how many apps will you still open?
title.zh-CN: 2026 年 10 月 19 日｜当 AI 开始替你用软件，你还会打开多少个 App？

description.en: An $85 yoga receipt was found by ChatGPT and entered into an expense system. As AI moves between software for us, which product will we open first, and which subscriptions will we keep paying for?
description.zh-CN: 一张 85 美元的瑜伽课收据，用户让 ChatGPT 找出来，填进报销系统。AI 开始替人来回切换软件之后，用户会先打开谁，又会把订阅费付给谁？

title.en: Oct 5–11, 2026 | AI turned in 722 mathematics papers and passed 9.4% of its legal tasks
title.zh-CN: 2026 年 10 月 5 日至 11 日｜AI 交了 722 篇数学论文，法律任务只过 9.4%

description.en: What AI took over this week, what it changed, and what people are arguing about. Mathematical proofs, clinic intake and live dashboards were taken; legal documents were not; call center jobs began shrinking 4% a year. Every item links to its source.
description.zh-CN: 这一周 AI 接手了什么、带来什么影响、大家在争什么。数学证明、诊所问诊、实时看板被接了过去；法律文书没接住；呼叫中心岗位开始每年少 4%。每一条都能点回原帖。

title.en: Oct 10, 2026 | Will AI replace SaaS? What are users still paying for?
title.zh-CN: 2026 年 10 月 10 日｜AI 会取代 SaaS 吗？用户到底为什么付费

description.en: Bespoke agents, established workflows and harder-to-sell side projects point to different questions. A source-linked analysis of what it would take to replace paid software.
description.zh-CN: Agent 按需造软件、老牌 SaaS 熟悉工作流程、副业项目越来越难出售，这三条线说的是不同问题。沿原始来源，分析替代付费软件还需要做到什么。

title.en: Sep 29–Oct 7, 2026 | Judgment now costs two cents
title.zh-CN: 2026 年 9 月 29 日至 10 月 7 日｜“做判断”只值两美分了

description.en: Five threads from nine days. Decision models became a category and started a price war. Evaluations moved from answering questions to doing long jobs. People handed whole chores to agents. Large models ran on personal machines. Open-weight releases came in a cluster.
description.zh-CN: 九天里的五条线：决策模型一周内变成品类并开始价格战；评测从答题变成让模型干一件长事；有人把杂事整件交给 agent；大模型跑进了自己的机器；开放权重模型密集发布。
